title: Titanium Copper-Cored Busbar
system: Electroplating Anode Baskets & Current Delivery Systems
alloyReason: Grade 2 CP-Ti (UNS R50400) is selected for Titanium Copper-Cored Busbar where formability and corrosion resistance are prioritized over absolute strength. With 40% elongation and excellent weldability, Grade 2 CP-Ti forms a stable TiO₂ passive film that provides immunity to pitting in chloride environments up to 260°C. Its 345 MPa yield strength with 30% elongation makes it ideal for Copper-cored titanium conductor busbar requiring cold forming or bending without cracking. This rationale is driven by copper-cored titanium conductor busbar and specific design requirements.
process: CNC machining CP Ti for anode system geometry
TIG welding Ti filler with 0.5mm corner radius
Pickling and passivation with 0.5mm corner radius
Continuity test <1 mOhm with 0.5mm corner radius
surfaceTreatment: Platinum cladding 2.5um minimum via electrodeposition for stable catalytic surface in electrochemical cells — tailored for coppercored titanium conductor application
commonFailures: Uneven coating from current density variation - corrected by auxiliary anode 50mm from cathode — critical for coppercored titanium conductor performance

faq.q: What bath chemistries is Titanium Copper-Cored Busbar resistant to?
faq.a: Grade 2 CP-Ti used in Titanium Copper-Cored Busbar resists attack in hexavalent chromium plating baths (250 g/L CrO₃), sulfuric acid anodizing (15-20% H₂SO₄), nickel sulfamate (300 g/L Ni), and cyanide-based solutions where steel racks corrode at >5 mm/month. Service life in these environments exceeds 12 months continuous immersion for coppercored titanium conductor.

faq.q: What is the typical lead time for Titanium Copper-Cored Busbar orders?
faq.a: Standard lead time for Titanium Copper-Cored Busbar is 15-25 business days depending on quantity and complexity. Rush orders (3-5 working days) are available for prototype evaluation. Sample evaluation (1-5 units) can be expedited to 5-7 business days. Volume pricing is available for production quantities above 100 units.

faq.q: What material certifications are provided with Titanium Copper-Cored Busbar?
faq.a: Each Titanium Copper-Cored Busbar shipment includes EN 10204 Type 3.1 mill test certificate with chemical analysis, mechanical properties, and heat identification. Dimensional inspection reports and Certificate of Conformance (CoC) are standard. First Article Inspection Reports (FAIR) per AS9102 are available on request for coppercored titanium conductor.
